content_html:
This is the third time I am writing this. The other two went wrong. Fuck the BS, let's get into what matters, learnings in hf stuff, AI and life.

Hedge Fund Stuff

1. Excel without mouse - makes life easier and more colorful. No friction. Just direct work
2. How markets rlly work - this is hard to define exactly, but before Verde, Faria Lima/Wall Street was a idealist company. "sell-side", "earnings preview", "expectations" were all kind of idealist terms that reflect much more stronger views than actually are. I talked with sell-side. I did my earnings preview. They fucking bought the stock. They are just people, smart (sometimes) people doing their job, hoping to get promoted, get rich and spend with their families (or at Vila). Sell-side reports are not sacred art works which represent the maximum level of enterprise intelligence society has achieved. They are just some junior analyst writing numbers that the senior analyst said while the partner was thinking if this was going to hurt company reputation. Every time you think they are some kind of fucking genius, remember that story about the education company who released 4 semesters instead of 3 in their earnings. They released saying it was a error. The stock grew by two-figures in the next day (just to make it clear THEY SAID IT WAS A FUCKING ERROR). Not just that, in the next year, the analysts FUCKING forgot that the number in the model in the previous year was wrong and, using that as parameters, grew their numbers by roughly 33% of what it should be. Like, what'd fuck.
3. How to think about stocks - there are three components to return: earnings increase, multiple re-rating, dividends. It all boils down to those three. That's what matter.
4. DDM > DCF - kind of contrarian here, but it's a rlly interesting approach. in the end is the money that you are receiving through dividends that matters. They should be close to each other (mainly DDM to FCFE) but they are not. Interesting take5. Modelling stuff - not just excel. But like. How to properly do a fuckin 3sm. 6. Building a portfolio - x-axis assimetry. y-axis conviction. markovitz in action. Simple, visual, but insightful about what matters. 7. Hypothesis - How a thesis should look like. Testable, measurable, specific. Exactly like a popper scientific hypothesis (wooow). That is cool. Making a scientific approach is exactly the type of intelectual shit I like about markets. Not BS, but a real philosophy to make work better.

AI

8. Explicit x Implicit - That is the one I want to dive and learn the most. The problem with AI use is that we don't a know a bunch of shit we know. That's what they call "judgement" or "taste". These are the things we can make and we know. But we cannot teach. Because it is implicit. I have to read more and learn here, but for me this seems to be part of the bottleneck of becoming an AI powered human being. (the other part is knowing what you want. and that's even harder, but more later)9. When you know what you want, you're set - my boss only wanted a dashboard where he could see the information that mattered, and some skill that did the modelling for him. simple. sweet. my only job was to ask claude to make it, and ask again when said it didn't. like, you just need to ask and don't be a retarded. Just agency (or whatever that word is supposed to mean)10. It's about the mindset - what can I simplify in my life. Do i know what I want? do I know what is explicit x implicit? Done. Totally done. In the same way founders say that you became "passion by the problem" and all that SEO bs, if you just try to solve problems in your own life, u should be fine

Life

All of the previous ones were also a huge part thankfully to Antonio. But I think those below are even more. I think overall he has a similar intelectual curiosity as I do. So a bunch of his approach and thinking are exactly the things I found the most interesting.11. The process - this one could be up in hf stuff, but is more than that. Is all about the process. Trust the process. This is our process. every. fucking. time.That's what I heard at my time there. The process to build something great, that works. Create it, work on it and trust it. That's for hf. for gym. for everything. 12. What is the best framework - I've lost many thinking hours wondering about the "framework", or the "MECE structure" I should use to think about stuff. fuck it. It is all frameworks. it's the map. it's, by definition, wrong and incomplete. Just think about the goal and use some initial mental model/framework that will help get there. "oh, but should I use this approach, or this other one that ortogonal? but this is incomplete, it lacks depth". shut the fuck up.x. Divergence x Convergencex. psychopaths win15. Sometimes you need to shine. Mostly, just don't do shit - (analogy motiva here16. No one. absolutely no one. gives a fuck about you17. about people (bahia)
